description: A grand entry foyer of distinguished traditional architecture, bathed in luminous natural light streaming from wide-open double front doors. The doors are matte black with multi-pane divided-light glass sidelights on both sides, and beyond them stretches a lush green garden with mature trees in full summer foliage and a stone paved path. The foyer walls are painted warm cream-white with applied moulding wainscoting panels running the full height. Above, a spectacular coffered ceiling is composed of deep white moulding grid beams with each coffered panel infilled with planks of natural bleached light oak, creating a warm contrast of white and pale wood. The ceiling has a slightly elevated quality suggesting a generous ceiling height. Warm ambient light fills the space evenly from the flood of outdoor daylight. Camera slightly elevated, one-point perspective looking straight toward the open double doors, lens at normal-to-wide character, level pitch. The ceiling installation zone is centered above and well-defined by the coffered grid. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
